description: Defines independent frontend-design comprehension cases for single-reference, overlap, skip, and non-UI routing behavior.

cases.title: Independently identify an admin and shared overlap

executor_input.prompt: Decide the applicable classifications and sources, then explain the safest change boundary for this task.

context.content: An admin rejection dialog must handle long detail, and a global width change to the shared Dialog has been proposed.

criteria.description: The reader independently identifies both Admin and Shared classifications and keeps usage-site composition as the first option.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/admin-business-operations.md and references/shared-design-system-components.md and skips Client, Learning, and Teacher references; the unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Select only one matching source, load every source, or approve a global default without shared-change evidence.

safety_vetoes.description: The reader misses either match or permits an unsafe global default change.

executor_input.prompt: Decide the sources needed for this task and explain the design obligations.

context.content: Plan the interaction design for a learner review sheet. No implementation mechanics or shared-component change is requested.

criteria.description: The reader independently classifies Learning Experience and retains cross-cutting focus, progression, feedback, mobile, keyboard, and accessibility rules.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/learning-experience.md and skips the other four design references; the unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Load irrelevant references or infer an engineering workflow task that the scenario did not request.

safety_vetoes.description: The reader misses Learning Experience or selects a materially wrong classification.

cases.title: Independently skip frontend design for non-UI documentation

executor_input.prompt: Decide whether a frontend skill or design source is needed for this task.

context.content: Correct wording in read-only server documentation. There is no user-interface behavior or visual design impact.

criteria.description: The reader independently concludes that neither frontend skill nor any frontend design reference is required.

expected_behavior: Do not force the task into the design taxonomy.
forbidden_behavior: Route frontend-design or select a design reference.

safety_vetoes.description: The reader routes frontend design for a non-UI documentation correction.

cases.title: Independently keep a teacher dialog change local

executor_input.prompt: Decide the applicable sources for this implementation and report which source groups are intentionally skipped.

context.content: Implement local composition for a teacher exercise dialog. The shared primitive and its defaults will not change.

criteria.description: The reader independently classifies Teacher Authoring, activates both frontend skills for implementation, and does not treat use of a shared primitive as a shared-component change.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/teacher-authoring.md and skips references/shared-design-system-components.md plus the other screen references; the unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Load the Shared reference merely because the feature uses Dialog.

safety_vetoes.description: The reader selects the Shared reference without a shared change or loses the feature-local boundary.
